name: Gatehouse
slug: Gatehouse governing keystone-operated gates and their passage.
description: A gatehouse containing the keystone-operated gates.

log.summary: The gatehouse requires a doorman to orient and calibrate keystones and ensure they are properly seated. Opening a gate requires leaving its keystone at the originating gatehouse; the gate remains open there until deliberately shut, and the keystone cannot be taken through to close it from the other side. The surrounding mountain contains ruined libraries and archives, with only roughly the upper third explored so far. Records were damaged or destroyed through both deliberate raiding and natural degradation. The party expects to guard the gatehouse for an extended period after resolving the lich situation.
notes: The gatehouse requires a doorman to orient and calibrate keystones and ensure they are properly seated.
